capabilities: Zoom editor font size with Ctrl+scroll when the mouse is in the editor area
Zoom the entire interface (sidebar, menus) when the mouse is outside the editor
Show an on-screen indicator of the current scale or font size
Customize zoom precision and modifier keys in settings
Reset font size to 16px or interface scale to 100%
extras: Users must disable Obsidian's built-in "Quick font size adjustment" before using the plugin; installation via BRAT or manual file placement is documented, and translations for English, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese are built in.
intentEvidence: Before using this plugin, go to Settings → Appearance and disable "Quick font size adjustment".
problem: Obsidian's built-in font size adjustment changes only editor text, so users cannot zoom the surrounding interface and editor independently from one control.
summary: Zone-based zoom plugin that scales the editor font when the mouse is over the editor and the whole interface scale elsewhere.
